scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Making Every Tool Call Count: Necessary Tool-Evidence Path Rewards for Agentic Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Xingming Long, Yu Liu, Zhiwei Yang, Hanqi Feng, Shaojie Zhang, Barnabas Poczos, Chao Jiang, Zhenbo Luo, Lei Jiang, Pei Fu
papers.abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can directly answer many image-grounded questions, yet they often struggle with complex queries requiring fine-grained visual details or external knowledge. To acquire this missing evidence, agentic VLMs invoke tools such as image cropping, image search, and text search. However, existing training paradigms primarily evaluate tool-use based on final answer correctness, leaving evidence acquisition and utilization insufficiently supervised. This leads to two critical shortcomings: (i) models frequently issue redundant or off-target tool calls that fail to gather necessary evidence, and (ii) even when appropriate tools are called, models often fail to extract the necessary information from the resulting observations. To address these limitations, we introduce the NTEP (Necessary Tool-Evidence Path), a novel annotation scheme that explicitly specifies the essential external evidence and corresponding tool calls for each query. Building upon this, we propose NTEP-R (NTEP Reward), a supervision mechanism ensuring that each tool invocation strictly advances the reasoning process toward the final solution. Specifically, our approach rewards the agent for aligning its pre-call intent with a necessary evidence-seeking goal, and for ensuring the information summarized from the post-call observation aligns with the necessary evidence. Furthermore, we introduce a non-repeated-goal regularizer to penalize redundant calls that revisit satisfied NTEP goals. Extensive evaluations on seven image-grounded benchmarks demonstrate that our 8B-parameter instantiation, NTEP-8B, significantly improves both search-oriented accuracy and tool-use efficiency within a unified three-tool framework. These results highlight the critical value of fine-grained tool-evidence path supervision for training robust agentic VLMs.
papers.summary: 为减少视觉搜索 Agent 的无效调用，论文以必要工具证据路径标注每个问题，分别奖励调用前的证据目标对齐、调用后的信息获取，并惩罚重复目标。NTEP-8B 在统一三工具框架下的七个评测切分平均准确率为 70.34，比复现的 SenseNova-MARS 高 2.03 点；搜索类任务平均调用次数由 2.54 降至 1.89。
papers.key_insight: 社区图文搜索可借鉴“本次检索要补齐哪条证据”的过程奖励，将查图、查帖和局部阅读绑定到明确的信息缺口，再用最终答案质量约束训练。结果支持同时考察准确率与调用预算；外部 Agent 经通用适配器接入同一工具接口，比较的是该框架下的表现，迁移时仍需验证原生工具差异与 nDCG。
papers.scoring_rationale: 直接优化主动搜索的证据获取和调用效率；有统一框架、消融和具体结果，但仅单次训练与评估，不能视为线上效果。

papers.title: When Users Don't Ask: Benchmarking Context-Driven Memory Retrieval in Conversational Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increas- ingly deployed as long-horizon conversational agents, motivating growing interest in mem- ory systems. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate memory through QA-style probing rather than in-situ conversational usage. We introduce LOCOMO-CONV, a conversa- tional memory benchmark derived from Lo- CoMo with four query styles: dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed. Across five rep- resentative memory systems, we evaluate both retrieval recall and end-to-end response qual- ity. Our experiments show that conversational framing exposes substantial retrieval gaps over- looked by QA benchmarks, especially on im- plicit and composed queries, which multi-facet query rewriting narrows for raw-turn mem- ory but not abstractive memory. We further find that strong retrieval does not fully trans- late into response quality, and that implicit queries exhibit silent grounding, where mem- ory improves contextual grounding without ex- plicitly surfacing the gold fact. These results point to reasoning-based memory elaboration as a promising direction, and we release aux- iliary supportive_memory annotations captur- ing conversationally useful context beyond the original gold evidence.
papers.summary: LoCoMo-Conv 将记忆问答改写成对话、隐式、反事实和组合四类请求，分别评估五种记忆系统的检索与回答。AnchorMem 的隐式查询 recall@10 为 0.368，多角度改写加 RRF 后升至 0.524；组合查询从 0.279 升至 0.432。摘要型记忆并未稳定受益，说明显式问答成绩难以代表真实对话。
papers.key_insight: 社区用户常通过上下文表达需求，可将“帮我找之前提到的做法”等隐式请求加入搜索 Agent 的离线集，同时检查多步证据召回和回答质量。原始帖子记忆适合尝试多角度改写，压缩后的记忆需要单独验证；不要把召回改善直接记作回答质量或 CTR 收益，还要检查反事实请求是否得到纠正。
papers.scoring_rationale: 与社区口语化查询、多轮检索直接相关；公开基准和消融可复用，未提供线上搜索指标。

papers.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.authors: Shubham Gandhi, Saurabh Goyal, Kiran Kate, Yara Rizk
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards works well when a task has a programmatic checker, but most long-horizon agent domains have none. We work in the outcome-blind setting, where ground-truth success signals are not available. Multi-criteria rubrics are a popular way to supply such a reward; they are scored once per trajectory, but a single scalar is a poor signal across tens of steps. We propose DRACO: Distributing Rubric-based Advantage for Credit Optimization. It generates rubrics dynamically during training to track the policy's evolving capability, scores those rubrics once per completed trajectory, and redistributes that judgment over the steps responsible for annotated rubrics to produce differentiated per-step advantages in GRPO. The redistribution is closed-form and does not introduce any trained attribution module. On AppWorld, DRACO gains 15.9 points over the base model and 5.3 points over GRPO trained with a sparse ground-truth reward, despite not using any verifiers itself. On out-of-domain Tau-Bench, it gains 5.3 points over the base model even without a frontier judge, beating both ground-truth-reward training and other rubric-based training settings. The code for DRACO is available at this https URL .
papers.summary: DRACO 面向缺少成功判定器的长程 Agent，用动态生成的细则评价完整轨迹，再将得分分配给承担对应细则的步骤，形成 GRPO 的分步优势。在 Qwen3.6-27B 上，AppWorld 常规测试任务成功率从 69.4% 升至 85.3%，比稀疏真实奖励训练高 5.3 点；三次均成功指标从 47.6% 升至 72.8%。
papers.key_insight: 社区复杂搜索往往难以用一个答案判定器覆盖质量，可围绕意图澄清、证据补齐、引用核验制定可检查的细则，再把奖励分配到具体检索决策。实施前要审计自动细则和裁判偏差，并用独立的人工相关性标注验证，避免把高裁判分误认作 nDCG、CTR 或事实正确率的改善。
papers.scoring_rationale: 长程工具调用训练可迁移到搜索；有多模型、消融和一致性评测，领域迁移仍需工程与独立奖励校准。

papers.title: Agentic Search. More accurate and efficient results from your AI systems.
papers.abstract: Mistral Search Toolkit provides search, open, navigate, read and grep in a multi-step retrieval loop. FinanceBench accuracy rises from 26.7% to 86%; OfficeQA Pro reaches 51.9%. Navigation reduces p90 latency from 255s to 154s.
papers.summary: Mistral 在已有索引上开放 search、open、navigate、read、grep 五种工具，让模型按证据缺口迭代查找和核实。官方评测中，FinanceBench 准确率由 26.7% 升至 86%，OfficeQA Pro 从 6.3% 升至 51.9%；加入定点导航后，FinanceBench 的 p90 延迟由 255 秒降至 154 秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可为长帖、楼层和引用提供稳定定位，把反复宽泛搜索改成“召回帖子—定位段落—核查证据”的循环。原文结果来自长文档和表格问答，不能直接外推至短文本排序；适合先在跨帖比较与复杂问答小流量试验，并同时记录答案依据、调用次数、nDCG 和尾延迟。
papers.scoring_rationale: 完整工具链便于落地，但以厂商自报的两个文档问答评测为主，与短文本社区存在领域差异。

papers.title: Building a Memory-Driven Agent with NVIDIA NemoClaw
papers.abstract: Enterprise work spans messages, decisions, projects, and obligations that change over time. An AI agent that starts without this context must reconstruct it...
papers.summary: NVIDIA 的记忆型 Agent 用 Markdown 维护人物、项目和优先级，用 SQLite 保存判断、修正与审计记录，任务执行时只读取有限相关上下文。在 186 道题上，整体准确率由 Agentic RAG 的 82.8% 升至 90.9%，31 道难题由 67.7% 升至 87.1%；单跳查询则由 86.7% 降至 83.3%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区多轮搜索，可把原帖证据、推导记忆与当前检索计划分开保存，并让用户纠正后续持续生效。结构化记忆有助于跨时间汇总，但单跳查询退步提示应按问题类型路由；原文涉及变化事实的子集仅 5 题，宜扩充本地评测，分别测实体消歧、引用覆盖和过期信息污染。
papers.scoring_rationale: 开源示例有直接复用路径；评测规模较小且存在退步，不按工业 A/B 证据计分。

papers.title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
papers.authors: Evan Chen, Shiqiang Wang, Christopher G. Brinton
papers.abstract: Distributed LLM-agent teams can read the latest shared facts and still act on an obsolete plan. A planner may derive an action from requirement $r_3$, another agent may commit $r_4$, and an executor may receive $r_4$ without replacing the plan derived from $r_3$. We call this \emph{stale-plan execution}: state freshness does not establish that the plan authorizing an action remains valid. We introduce PlanFence, a dependency-scoped action-validation protocol. Plans cite the exact public records they used, and an executor validates only the records that can affect the pending external action, replanning once or blocking when validation is incomplete. In 30 controlled live workflows with a post-plan revision, a freshness-only executor acts on the obsolete plan in every task, whereas PlanFence completes all tasks without an invalid action. Controlled replay reveals two conditional boundaries: proactive synchronization yields lower coordination stall at low churn, while PlanFence avoids repeated update-path coordination as churn grows and avoids validating unrelated state as the shared keyspace grows. These are controlled safety and systems-cost results, not general task-accuracy gains.
papers.summary: PlanFence 针对“已收到新事实却继续执行旧计划”的失效，要求计划记录所依赖的具体版本，并在行动前仅校验相关依赖。30 个受控实时流程中，单纯检查最新状态的方法全部沿用旧计划，PlanFence 无无效行动；高更新回放中它在 330 次行动上同样为零，协调等待为每次 230.8 毫秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 若跨轮缓存证据和查询计划，应将计划绑定到帖子版本、删除状态与用户约束，在输出或下一次工具调用前重验受影响依赖。该方法提供可追溯的失效条件，但论文刻意构造了计划后修订，不能把零失效率当成通用质量保证；低更新率场景也需比较主动同步成本。
papers.scoring_rationale: 版本依赖适合变化中的社区内容；受控实验验证协议效果，尚无大规模线上检索证据。

papers.title: KC-Bench: A Dynamic Interactive Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Conflicts in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yaxing Lyu, Shengjie Zhou, Binbin Toh, Pengyu Zhu, Lijun Li
papers.abstract: As LLMs increasingly act through tools, they must reconcile user instructions, parametric knowledge, and dynamic environmental observations before taking actions. We introduce KC-Bench, a controlled multi-turn benchmark for measuring this capability across world-knowledge conflicts, input inconsistencies, and multi-source temporal conflicts. Its 238 tasks are manually screened from more than 1,000 generated candidates and combine a user simulator, stateful tools, deterministic environment assertions, an open-source natural-language evaluator, and human trajectory verification. Evaluation of nine models, including DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3, shows substantial cross-domain variation: no model handles factual correction, identity consistency checking, and temporal conflict resolution reliably across all settings. In the simulated environments, missed conflicts can propagate to tool calls or synthetic protected-data flows. KC-Bench isolates this model-level behavior rather than ranking complete agent frameworks, and provides a reproducible diagnostic for developing conflict-aware reasoning and execution safeguards.
papers.summary: KC-Bench 将事实错误、输入身份不一致和多源时序冲突注入可交互环境，形成 238 个任务，并结合状态断言与人工核验评估九种模型。GLM-5.2 的人工核验成功率在三个域分别为 53.52%、61.96% 和 65.75%，没有模型在全部场景中稳定解决冲突，展示了工具调用前核对证据的缺口。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子会同时包含旧结论、更正和相互矛盾的描述，可借鉴该基准把“识别冲突后是否继续错误调用”纳入 Agent 搜索评测。构造题目时保留可达证据和唯一冲突点，并分别统计检测、澄清与最终回答；论文测的是固定提示和模拟环境下的模型行为，不代表完整产品的可靠性。
papers.scoring_rationale: 冲突与时效判断贴近 UGC 证据质量；基准可复现，但每任务仅单次试验，证据质量保守给 3。

papers.title: Speculative Macro Commit for Faster Tool-Using Agents
papers.authors: Zeyu Liu, Souvik Kundu, Peter A. Beerel
papers.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents spend wall-clock time not only on model inference but also in serial action--observation turns, where each tool call, environment transition, and observation can delay subsequent decisions. We introduce \textbf{Speculative Macro Commit} (SMC), a runtime mechanism for a two-tier agent system: a large authoritative actor model produces the official trajectory, while a faster speculative drafter model continuously predicts and executes future action chains on an isolated environment snapshot. SMC mines recurring multi-action skeletons from training traces and stores them in a macro library used to match against action chains predicted by the drafter at runtime. When the actor's next tool call matches the first drafted action, SMC commits the remaining pre-executed draft steps, together with their observations, to the official trajectory. Using Qwen3.5-27B INT4 as the authoritative actor model and Qwen3.5-4B as the speculative drafter model, SMC matches the sequential agent's overall accuracy while reducing latency by 10.23\% over the Speculative Actions (SA) baseline and 18.59\% over sequential execution on the $\tau^2$-Bench Telecom subset. On AppWorld, SMC reduces wall time by 7.7\% over SA baseline and 44.9\% over sequential execution, with a small reduction in task completion. Overall, SMC provides a practical way to reuse multi-step speculative execution and reduce agent latency beyond single-step speculative actions. Our code is publicly available \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{magenta}{here}}.
papers.summary: SMC 让小模型在隔离环境快照上预执行动作链，用轨迹挖掘出的宏匹配候选，主模型确认首步后复用后续结果。在电信工具任务中，平均延迟由 27.60 秒降至 22.47 秒，准确率保持 99.52%；AppWorld 延迟下降 44.93%，任务完成数则从 70/168 降至 68/168。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可以先在只读、可重放的检索链上试验推测执行，关注用户请求中重复出现的查帖与取证模式。必须验证候选链与当前状态一致，不能仅凭模板命中直接复用；论文推测配置用了三张 GPU、串行基线为一张，采购或上线前应同时计算总算力成本和成功率。
papers.scoring_rationale: 对多步搜索延迟有迁移价值，但依赖环境快照与额外算力，且出现任务完成率退步。

papers.title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
papers.authors: Jie Wu, Zhenru Zhang, Beichen Zhang, Xuwu Wang, Yuhui Su, Mouxiang Chen, Peng Wang, Zhihai Wang, Que Shen, Hao Zhou, An Yang, Fei Huang, Yujiu Yang, Dayiheng Liu
papers.abstract: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. Rather than generating environments from scratch, we observe that the tool-execution history in existing trajectories exposes the structure and contents of the environments in which they ran, making it possible to reconstruct those environments from the trajectories themselves. Thus, we introduce Terminal-Universe, a framework which turns each trajectory into a reusable environment and explores it for synthesizing new tasks and continued interactions. Specifically, Terminal-Universe replays the file operations recorded in a trajectory to restore each file before the agent modified it, yielding a partial workspace; a completion agent then supplies the missing files and dependencies. On this recovered workspace, we both reconstruct the original intent task and synthesize entirely new ones. Besides, we also scale the tasks along two complementary axes: breadth and depth. For breadth, we mine directional dependency relations between related environments and synthesize cross-workspace queries spanning multiple codebases, as developers routinely do in real-world development. For depth, we extend the initial single-turn query into a multi-round session that captures iterative user feedback and requirement refinement via a user agent. Applied to public terminal agent trajectories, Terminal-Universe produces 37.3k task-sufficient environments. Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on this corpus improves single-round performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1 by 11.9 points and multi-round performance on EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 by 13.8 points.
papers.summary: Terminal-Universe 从 Agent 历史文件操作反推初始工作区，再补全依赖，重建原任务并生成跨工作区、多轮新任务。框架得到 3.73 万个可用环境；以 3.2 万条筛选轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-27B 后，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 46.2% 升至 58.1%，多轮 MT@4 从 6.3% 升至 20.1%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索可迁移的是把静态工具日志恢复成可重放环境，再生成追问、证据变更与跨帖任务，而非直接套用终端任务分数。优先固定索引快照、工具版本和检验规则，对比原始轨迹模仿与重求解训练；工作区重建和教师轨迹生成有成本，短文本召回本身仍需独立评测。
papers.scoring_rationale: 环境重建有技术新意和消融，终端代码领域与社区检索间接相关，工程成本较高。

papers.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
papers.abstract: Inside OpenAI, coding agents are reshaping AI research. Explore early data on agent usage, experiment velocity, task complexity, and research acceleration.
papers.summary: OpenAI 报告其研究团队使用编程 Agent 的内部观察，并按决策、设计、构建、运行、分析和沟通六类活动分析变化。截至八月中旬，每个人类工作日对应 3.1 个 Agent 工作日；按 API 价格折算，中位研究人员每日使用超过 600 美元推理，90 分位超过 7000 美元。实验量增加与采用率相关，但算力也在增长。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索团队可据此将 Agent 提效评估拆成数据准备、实验执行和结果分析，分别衡量完成质量、等待时间及推理成本，再观察有效搜索实验的产出。原文是团队内部的描述性数据，Token 用量、代码量和实验数不能证明业务价值；是否改善 nDCG 或 CTR，仍应由受控实验决定。
papers.scoring_rationale: 提供真实团队采用证据和测量边界，适合作为工业实践补充；没有搜索效果的因果实验。
